claim: Nodal signaling is the only pathway affected at early stages in ybx1 mutants.
source_text: Our use of a temperature-sensitive ybx1 allele, that allows selective and conditional disruption of maternal Ybx1 function at early stages, shows that Nodal signaling is the only pathway affected at these stages in the mutants.
